train_val.source_group_independence_caveat: per-family/per-trajectory blocked split => train and val SHARE lineages (val = held-out frames from the same source groups, NOT independent lineages). Single-lineage domains (HIGH_T_LIQUID, OTHER_RELEVANT_SIO: 1 group; STOICHIOMETRIC_AMORPHOUS production=1 trajectory) are interpolation-within-lineage, not cross-lineage generalization. Whole-trajectory holdout not possible (too few independent lineages per domain); blocked+buffer is the §6B fallback.

labeling_cost_estimate.note: Allegro teacher inference cost ~ N_atoms (~1.02M atoms total); no labeling performed

domain_balance_justification: dilute+clustered = 62% of frames directly targets the deployment oxygen-deficient regime (teacher's weakest domain); amorphous 640 is the matrix; broad replay (crystal 600 + surface 450 + liquid 313 + other 108) retained for MD stability. High-pressure crystalline trimmed because deployment is ambient. Counts driven by pool availability + deployment relevance, not target percentages.
